card.title: How To Fix Poco X3 Pro Dead or Camera Not Working or No Audio Issue

source.title: How To Fix Poco X3 Pro Dead or Camera Not Working or No Audio Issue

claims.statement: Poco X3 / X3 Pro with no power, dead cameras and no audio that stalls at about 0.150 A on a DC supply after power-on has a known CPU solder-joint failure from thermal stress and board flex.
After ruling out rail shorts, PMIC, battery and display, the fix is a CPU reball.

procedure: Check main rails for shorts; rule out PMIC/battery/display.
Preheat, remove CPU, clean, reball, refit.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
